reuse.why: Uses the shared getVisibleCategoriesWithoutTemplates selection, batchMessages, setBudget, getSheetValue and the sum-amount sheet cell like the other month-wide actions.

duplication.why: Repeats the per-action loop skeleton (income/tracking skip and expense sign flip) that every month-wide action already copies, but adds no new logic copy beyond that convention.

placement.why: The action sits in budget/actions.ts beside setZero and the average actions and is registered in budget/app.ts with mutator(undoable(...)) like its siblings.

scope.why: Focused on the new action, but the test change also removes the income-cat setup from the unrelated copyUntilYearEnd suite.

maintainability.why: Short and consistent with neighbouring actions; the repeated income-skip/sign skeleton remains a shared pattern not extracted.
